title: Kotlin Masterclass: Modern Android & Multiplatform
subtitle: Master Kotlin 2.0, Null Safety, Coroutines, Flow, Jetpack Compose, and Kotlin Multiplatform.

mods.title: Module 1: Kotlin Syntax, Null Safety & Types
mods.desc: val/var, null safety, Elvis operator (?:), and smart casts.

mods.title: Module 2: Data Classes, Extension Functions & Lambdas
mods.desc: Data classes, custom extensions, and higher-order functions.

mods.title: Module 3: Coroutines, Flow Streams & Compose
mods.desc: suspend functions, Coroutines, Flow, and UI architecture.

title: Swift & SwiftUI Masterclass: iOS & macOS App Engineering
subtitle: Master Swift 5.9/6, Protocol-Oriented Programming, Optionals, Closures, and SwiftUI architecture.

mods.title: Module 1: Swift Basics, Optionals & Control Flow
mods.desc: Constants, variables, optional binding (if let / guard let).

mods.title: Module 2: Structs, Protocols & Extensions
mods.desc: Value types (structs), protocol contracts, and extensions.

mods.title: Module 3: SwiftUI Declarative UI & State Management
mods.desc: @State, @Binding, View hierarchy, and reactive UI updates.
mods.starter: print("SwiftUI updates UI views automatically when @State variables mutate.")

title: Ruby & Rails Masterclass: Full-Stack Web Development
subtitle: Master Ruby 3.2, Object-Oriented Mixins, Blocks, Procs, Lambdas, Metaprogramming, and Ruby on Rails.

mods.title: Module 1: Ruby Syntax, Symbols & OOP Basics
mods.desc: Dynamic typing, symbols, string interpolation, and classes.
mods.starter:
class Course; attr_accessor :title; end
c = Course.new; c.title = "Ruby 3.2"
puts "Active: #{c.title}"

mods.title: Module 2: Blocks, Procs, Lambdas & Enumerable
mods.desc: Custom block yields, Procs, Lambdas, and Enumerable methods.
mods.starter:
def run_twice; yield; yield; end
run_twice { puts "Yielded block executed" }

mods.title: Module 3: Ruby on Rails MVC & Metaprogramming

title: Dart & Flutter Masterclass: Cross-Platform Mobile
subtitle: Master Dart 3.x, Sound Null Safety, Futures, Streams, Mixins, and Flutter mobile architecture.

mods.title: Module 1: Dart Syntax, Null Safety & Collections
mods.desc: Variables, records, patterns, sound null safety, and lists/maps.

mods.title: Module 2: OOP, Mixins & Abstract Classes
mods.desc: Classes, mixins, factory constructors, and interfaces.

mods.title: Module 3: Futures, Streams & Async Flutter Architecture
mods.desc: Futures, async/await, Stream controllers, and state management.
mods.starter:
Future<String> load() async => "Data loaded";
void main() async => print(await load());

title: R Programming: Statistical Analysis & Data Science
subtitle: Master R 4.x, Vectorization, Data Frames, Tidyverse (dplyr), and ggplot2 visualizations.

mods.title: Module 1: R Syntax, Vectors & Vectorized Math
mods.desc: Vector arithmetic, 1-based indexing, factors, and matrices.

mods.title: Module 2: Data Frames & Tidyverse Data Wrangling
mods.desc: Data frames, filter, select, mutate, and summarization in R.
mods.starter:
df <- data.frame(item = c("A", "B"), score = c(95, 88))
print(summary(df))

mods.title: Module 3: ggplot2 Visualizations & Statistical Modeling
mods.desc: Grammar of graphics, aesthetics, and linear regression models.
